- Item 3 mentions a Ferrari 288 GTO model, which is the same Ferrari project, but there is nothing about its start date beyond the above.
- None of the items mention a Porsche 991 Turbo S model, so I have no start date for it.

Step 2: Reason.
The Ferrari's start date is known (about three weeks before May 23, 2023). The Porsche's is not in these items, so I cannot compare the two. Nothing here says whether the Porsche was started before or after the Ferrari.

Answer: The memory items don't mention the Porsche 991 Turbo S model, so I can't say which was started first. The only date I have is for the Ferrari, which you began about three weeks before May 23, 2023, on a Sunday afternoon. If you tell me when you began the Porsche, I can compare the two.
